t.why: Near Indian Ocean shipping lanes, it draws interest from both India and China.
t.rel: An Indian Ocean island country where an Indian plan to build a military facility was blocked by public opposition. It cooperates with Indian Ocean island states such as Mauritius and Madagascar through the Indian Ocean Commission and has joined efforts against piracy.
t.know: Almost half its land is protected nature reserve.
t.etext: Tourism, tuna fishing and tuna canning are the heart of the economy. Its income per person is among the highest in Africa.
